comparison.objective: Route a rigid bar beneath a bracket and between clips to a stop; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained planar sliding and clearance alignment versus coaxial tool insertion, bimanual impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Bar flat between both clips with its end within 8 mm of the stop versus four contact-loaded fractures and complete safe tang containment.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment is generic; the benchmark does not test impact fracture, retained-coil protection, or recovery of released fragments.
